title: Penalty for** **[7][contraventions] in relation to furnishing of information
text:
45. Penalty for [contraventions] in relation to furnishing of information.—[(1) Without

prejudice to the provisions of [sub-section (6) of section 6 and] section 44, if a person, who furnishes or
is required to furnish under this Act any particulars, documents or any information,—

(a) makes any statement or furnishes any document which he knows or has reason to believe to

be false in any material particular; or
